implementation.activation: Explicit ctx-aware helpers require an own private V8 brand, reader.owner===ctx and reader.db===ctx.db. Hidden self-bound reader is never copied to native/source views or serialized. No production bypass flag, public endpoint, or generic db.query interception.
implementation.raw: Original execution by_attempt take(2), historical-owner execution take(2), and guard tool-list by_attempt kind=tool take(33). Original query/index/equality construction executes on every logical call before terminal-result reuse. Arrays are detached; duplicate cardinality and original exceptions remain in callers.
implementation.bounds: Raw arrays and successful exact-byte SHA-256 strings share the existing512-entry/1,000,000-byte map with managed source rows. Operation keys are distinct and key bytes count toward bounds. No cached errors, promises, verdicts, hydrated execution objects, model/financial rows or by_operation results.
implementation.writers: Evict all new execution/tool/hash families before AND after every writer, including known control/finance, unknown/component/fluent/pending/failing paths. Reuse suppressed during writes; graph epoch rejects late population; concurrent misses do not share promises. Existing source/authority/policy/transcript invalidation remains independent.
implementation.hash: Every actual current message/content/policy/selection value is canonicalized and every digest comparison still runs. Only SHA-256 over the exact current immutable string can reuse a success. Optional ctx preserves original digest behavior in default/public/V7/undefined contexts. No canonical serialization/parse or validation memo.
implementation.freshFences: withNativeSnapshotReads remains unbranded and carries no new reader despite sharing the old db Proxy; all5 inline empty-save raw control reads remain original, as do its hashes. All4 by_operation reads and all financial/authority/source/currentness/lease/tool/budget/expiry predicates retain original order.
